source.title: The top 9 reasons startups fail
source.sample: 431 VC-backed startups that publicly shut down since 2023; reasons could be identified for 385 of them
source.note: A startup can have more than one reason, so the shares add up to more than 100%. The nine shares were read from the report's chart; the first four are also stated in its text and are re-checked against the live page.

reasons.how: The scorecard rates what the idea needs to build. It does not model cash or runway.

reasons.covered_by: Idea check: problem and market scores, devil's advocate, research papers
reasons.how: Problem Validation and Market Demand scores, the devil's advocate, and the novelty index against research papers.

reasons.reason: Wrong market timing or macro conditions
reasons.covered_by: Research papers: papers per year, live market search
reasons.how: Shows whether research on the topic is active (papers per year) and what the market search found now.
The nearest signal is the go-to-market score. There is no cost or pricing model.
The judge says whether to go ahead, change direction or stop, with the mitigations it requires.

reasons.covered_by: Market tab and Competition & Defensibility score
reasons.how: Competitors from the live web search, the closest research papers, and the Competition & Defensibility score.
Team and leadership are not assessed by this project.

reasons.covered_by: Technical Feasibility score, Prototype tests, Codebase Evaluation, Failure Simulator
reasons.how: The prototype is tested and run, and the Failure Simulator finds where the code would fail.

reasons.covered_by: Risk Assessment score, Failure Simulator (secrets, injection)
reasons.how: Legal and security risks in the scorecard, and security weaknesses in the code. Fraud is not assessed.
